items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he sounded more like Ellington to me... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I don't know what the hell he sounded like...

ctx.x: As far as I'm concerned, uh, he played the, he couldn't even play a horn as far as I'm concerned. No. And his style was, was pretty bad as far as I'm concerned. That's, that's my opinion. Yeah.
I just wanted, cause he had, you know, there was a lot of territory bands. He sounded more like Ellington to me than any else.
Well, I don't know what the hell he sounded like, but the, that style, that style and the sound to me, I, I stayed away from. You know, that's my personal opinion. Yeah.
